translations.web: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
translations.bsb: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me.”
translations.kjv: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part
translations.asv: where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: Jehovah do so to me, and more also, if aught but death part thee and me.
